title: Distribute agricultural chemicals from the air only under licence
what: Conduct an aerial spraying business only under an aerial spraying business licence, with pilots holding a pilot (chemical rating) licence.

laws.title: Agricultural and Veterinary Chemicals (Control of Use) Act 2004 (NT)

sources.title: Agricultural and Veterinary Chemicals (Control of Use) Act 2004 (NT)
sources.quote: A person must not: (a) conduct an aerial spraying business; or (b) represent that he or she provides an aerial spraying service for fee or reward, unless the person: (c) is authorised under an aerial spraying business licence

sources.title: Agricultural and Veterinary Chemicals (Control of Use) Act 2004 (NT)
sources.quote: A person must not pilot an aircraft to carry out aerial spraying unless the person: (a) is authorised under a pilot (chemical rating) licence
